messages:
emma: opened PR #5264 to refresh the hello-orbit quickstart — goal is a lean first-run: ephemeral token demo, short server-exchange note, GH Pages deploy snippet, and fix sample links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5264

rick: nice. question: are we showing service-account style tokens anywhere or keeping the guide client-first?

emma: main path is client-first ephemeral tokens for onboarding. added a compact "When to use service accounts" sidebar with pros/cons and a link to the advanced guide.

zara: CI linkcheck failed: docs reference /samples/orbit-old which no longer exists in samples repo.

ci-bot: build failed  jobs/docs/linkcheck  1 broken link: /samples/orbit-old -> 404

emma: fixed sample path to /samples/orbit-starter and added a note recommending pinning the sample commit SHA to avoid drift. pushed a follow-up commit.

hugo: quick nit: GH Pages snippet sets REDWOOD_APP_KEY but our JS snippets use REDWOOD_KEY in some places. can we standardize?

rick: prefer REDWOOD_KEY. shorter and matches most examples. include a compatibility table for legacy env names.

emma: standardized on REDWOOD_KEY across the quickstart and added an env var mapping table showing legacy names and scope differences. also added a one-liner about token expiry and suggested refresh cadence for demos.

zara: add a tiny local-dev CORS troubleshooting box — folks new to GH Pages hit CORS when testing callback URLs. include a curl check for Access-Control-Allow-Origin and an example of an allowed-origins header.

emma: added the curl check and a short explanation of common callback URL mistakes. included the GH Pages deploy step: `git checkout gh-pages && mkdocs gh-deploy` and a snippet showing `REDWOOD_KEY` set via Actions secrets.

hugo: editorial: change "production-ready" phrasing to "recommended for demo/staging" so we don't imply enterprise readiness in the quickstart.

emma: updated wording. also included a three-bullet migration checklist for teams moving from PKCE/service-account workflows to ephemeral tokens: (1) token exchange endpoint, (2) refresh cadence and TTL mapping, (3) scope equivalence notes plus pointer to sample token-exchange code.

ci-bot: linkcheck OK; docs/lint noted a minor sentence-length warning in docs/quickstart-hello-orbit.md:line 54.

zara: could we add a tiny GitHub Action step to run `npm ci && npm run build` on the sample repo when sample links change? would catch breakages earlier.

emma: good idea  added a minimal check step that runs in docs CI for PRs touching sample links. requested review from @rick and @zara.

rick: approved :thumbsup: thanks for the migration notes and GH Pages snippet.

zara: approved. merging after green main CI and will backport a short note to release-2.x.

emma: merged PR #5264 (commit mno345) into main. follow-up: opening a docs-only PR to update the samples README with the env var naming recommendations and a tiny compatibility table. thanks everyone!
